notes.text: 01 GUARDED TRANSIMPEDANCE
02 ADC CONDITIONING
03 DIFFERENTIAL ADC

All voltages on this sheet reference AGND.
SUM has no clamp or probe point. R1 || C1: 1 ms nominal.
I_abs electron deposition gives V_TIA = +I_abs x 100 Mohm.
Do not connect SUM directly to the bias supply.

V_A0 = 1.648358 - (10/40.2) V_TIA
V_A1 = 1.650 V nominal. Dark-zero and gain calibration required.
PGA +/-256 mV gives 0.3141 pA per raw code; not measured sensitivity.
04 LOCAL BYPASS / QUIET ADC REFERENCE

UNBUILT PROTOTYPE
No measured leakage, noise, stability, settling, or imaging resolution.
LMC662 and feedback geometry preserved from the original detector.

sheets.title: 9-30 V input / onboard buck / isolated converter

notes.text:
INPUT / BUCK: nominal 12 V or 24 V on the SAME connector; regulated 9-30 V envelope.
F1 and D100 protect wiring/polarity; no surge or mains-input rating is claimed.

BUCK5 = 0.6*(1+101/13.5) = 5.08889 V nominal; both resistors 0.1%.
500 kHz forced PWM. Keep VIN/GND capacitors at U10; compact SW area.
Calculated DC range 4.999-5.179 V before trace/ripple; verify supply margin under load.
2x22 uF output and 10 uH are based on TI's 5 V reference design.
ISOLATED RAW RAILS / LOCAL REGULATION ON NEXT SHEET

R05P09D/P: +/-9 V, 55 mA per rail. 1.30k preloads maintain >=10% load.
Basic 250 VAC rms working isolation; 6.4 kV DC is a 1-second TEST, not a working rating.
4-10 pF isolation capacitance; neither filtering nor an ERC pass proves pA noise.

LOCAL +/-5 V: references are AGND. DNC pin 7 is intentionally open.
10 uF input/output +10 nF NR and feedforward follow TI low-noise recommendations.
Measure loaded rail voltage, ripple, startup and detector noise before use.

Positive nominal 5.0007 V; negative nominal -4.98624 V.
The raw converter is unregulated: preload and postregulation are required.
Collector local rails are voltages RELATIVE TO FCOM, not chamber ground.

overview_descriptions.analog:
J1 SUM -> guarded LMC662 -> conditioning -> ADS1115.
100 Mohm feedback, 10 pF; all local voltages reference AGND.
Preserved 16 mm SUM trace; no copper plane under the input.
overview_descriptions.power:
J2 regulated 9-30 V DC -> fuse -> reverse diode -> buck.
LMR51420XF: 500 kHz forced PWM; 5.08889 V nominal.
R05P09D/P provides isolated raw positive/negative rails.
overview_descriptions.power_rails:
Raw +/-9 V -> preload and RC filters -> TPS7A regulators.
Quiet +5VA and -5VA reference AGND; local 3.3 V for ADC.
55 mA per raw rail; verify ripple, headroom and temperature.
overview_descriptions.readout:
ATmega328P at 3.3 V / 8 MHz acquires ADS1115 samples.
Two wide DIP optical channels carry 38400 baud UART.
HOST_VIO is a 3.3 V input; isolated ICSP requires discharged bias.
overview_descriptions.bias:
TPS2553 latch-off switch supplies CA02P-5; U23 senses output.
Supply-ready AND host release enable the filtered manual setpoint.
0-2.048 V program: nominal 0-200 V raw bias; default clamped zero.
overview_descriptions.bias_filter:
Two 10 kohm / 1 W filters feed FCOM through rated capacitors.
Raw and final bleeders remain independent of host software.
Collector connects only to SUM; rated discharge check is required.

notes.text: POWER AND REFERENCE

Input: regulated 9-30 V DC, nominal 12 or 24 V.
Buck: 5.08889 V nominal; divider resistors 0.1%.
Analog: +5VA / -5VA and local 3.3 V.
AGND joins PGND only at R149 beside the converter input return.
ESP32 is powered separately. No gun or filament connection.
SIGNAL AND CONNECTORS

J1: 1 SUM specimen input, 2 AGND guard / shield.
J2: 1 VIN, 2 PGND. J4: both pins PGND / chamber.
J3: 1 GND, 2 reference output, 3 SDA, 4 SCL, 5 RDY.
SDA -> ESP32 GPIO21; SCL -> GPIO22; RDY optional.
MECHANICAL AND VALIDATION

170 x 100 mm, two copper layers, four 3.2 mm NPTH holes.
Use insulating nylon / PEEK fasteners and standoffs.
Native ERC/DRC and pin-map audits accompany the package.
These checks do not establish measured analog performance.
UNBUILT ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE

Validate leakage, noise, stability, settling and calibration.
Inspect construction and clean the high-impedance input.
No measured sensitivity or microscope resolution is claimed.
Commission first with a current-limited bench supply.
Check rails and detector baseline before microscope wiring.

mechanical.fasteners: insulating nylon/PEEK standoffs and fasteners; no grounded metal on collector board
